name: ColourField
summary: One colour a person can choose, clear or leave undefined: a labelled swatch that opens the ColourPicker in a popover. Not for choosing among a fixed set of colours (use SegmentedControl or Select), or for showing a token's colour (use TokenSpecimen). Added for the Colour page's numbered brand colours (owner, F7d, 2026-11-07).
a11y: The ColourPicker's swatch button, named by `label` and the hex, fills the whole swatch, so a click, a tap, Enter or Space opens the picker as a dialog (Escape closes it and returns focus); the focus ring draws around the swatch. An undefined colour is a dashed, empty swatch with words that say so, never colour alone.  Clear is a separate quiet icon-only Button named "Clear" plus the label, present only while the colour can be cleared. The swatch is a 64 px square target.

keys.keys: Enter or Space on the swatch

keys.action: moves from the swatch to Clear

props.name: mark
props.description: The short visible mark that names the field, e.g. "1". Shown above the swatch.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's accessible name, e.g. "Brand colour 1".

props.name: value
props.description: The colour as #rrggbb, or undefined when it isn't defined.

props.name: name
props.description: What the colour is called, e.g. "Indigo"; shown under the swatch with its hex value.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The new colour, as the person moves through the picker. It applies at once; the owner of the value decides how it's kept.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Makes the colour not defined. Leave out when it can't be cleared, and say why nearby.

props.name: tag
props.description: One or two words beside the mark for a role this colour plays, e.g. "Accent".

props.name: suggestion
props.description: What the picker starts at when the colour isn't defined.

props.name: emptyText
props.default: 'Not defined. Choose a colour to add it.'
props.description: Under an undefined swatch: why it's empty and what to do. Default: "Not defined. Choose a colour to add it."
